summary: Portable advisory Python measurement runtime, target-aware settings/setup, format-5 neutral reports and empty-folder baselines, with T-001.3 foundation discovery guidance and installed-composition test authority. Later task-flow integration and live agent compliance remain outside this record.

provides.name: portable-measurement-cli
provides.summary: Source and installed launchers use adjacent runtime resources without a source-checkout or global fallback. Preserve baseline/compare/measure, --root, file/folder scopes and --output. setup --root explicitly provisions target-native pinned dependencies; measurement never provisions them. Format-5 JSON/text reports use neutral increased/decreased classifications and highlights while retaining threshold and interpretation signals; older formats are incompatible baselines. baseline accepts explicitly selected existing directories with an empty included Python inventory; ordinary empty measure, missing/excluded scopes and comparisons outside captured coverage fail. Complete breached measurements exit 0; invalid, incomplete or incompatible measurements exit 2.

provides.name: foundation-native-and-advisory-discovery
provides.summary: Foundation guidance discovers native checks once through an existing registry/equivalent or documented commands and exposes enabled installed advisory measurement beside them. Carry command, governed scope, policy reference, requiredness and declared stage owner. Preserve whole-project scope and existing review duties; reuse aggregate evidence only for matching scope, policy and checked bytes. Missing/stale required proof retains its native owner and recovery route. No new linter, typechecker, mandatory registry, runner or review stage is introduced. This is foundation guidance, not completed downstream task-flow integration or agent-compliance qualification.

artifacts.name: runtime-defaults-pins-and-effective-settings
artifacts.summary: The launcher, helpers, flat defaults and pins are installation-local. Each target .quality/maintainability.toml and .quality/ruff.toml independently replaces its shipped default when present; invalid present settings fail without fallback. Effective maintainability policy requires a non-empty profile string, a non-empty list of supported checks (complexity, ruff), a non-negative integer complexity_target excluding Booleans, and an exclude_directories list of non-empty strings. Invalid policy fails before scanning or report publication, with the settings path and invalid field in the diagnostic. Unrelated root Ruff configuration is ignored. identity.settings records origin, path and SHA-256 for each effective file; effective contents, not provenance paths/origins, determine settings compatibility.

artifacts.name: original-baseline-report
artifacts.summary: The tool portion of ART-002 is a named format-5 JSON report and sibling text summary containing captured source snapshots/hashes, folder coverage and measurement identity. An explicitly selected existing empty folder captures known absence; later covered additions have unknown numeric before/delta values rather than zero. Repeated comparisons can retain the same original baseline with fresh output names; a collision with either report sibling refuses overwrite. Capture-before-edit and retention through corrections remain caller workflow obligations, not enforced workflow integration.

artifacts.name: native-check-policy-discovery
artifacts.summary: The optional gates template carries native command, scope, owner, requiredness and policy references plus enabled advisory command/setup and settings references. It is command discovery only; native policy remains authoritative and measurement thresholds stay in effective settings.

artifacts.name: installed-composition-verification-authority
artifacts.summary: Reusable local tests exercise a disposable installation from an unrelated cwd after deleting its source distribution: dirty/staged/untracked capture, edits/additions/deletions, empty-folder capture, settings and refusal cases, report/source/index preservation, managed-resource drift/refresh, and real native F401 failure beside successful advisory measurement. Real analyzer cases require pinned tools; skips do not qualify them. T-001.3 results record implementation execution claims and limits, not independent acceptance or live agent behavior.

state_owned.name: target-native-analyzer-environments
state_owned.summary: Explicit setup creates or repairs target .quality/envs/<key>, keyed by OS, CPU, Python implementation/full version and installation pin hash. Measurement selects that native environment or an already pinned caller; legacy/foreign environments are not fallback runtimes. Missing pins report an executable setup recipe for the selected target.

invariants.statement: Metrics remain advisory and do not waive native hard repository checks. Foundation discovery preserves native policy, scope and ownership, and does not duplicate current aggregate-covered checks merely for reporting.

Measurement captures actual dirty, staged and untracked source bytes without changing source or the real index; saved JSON/text reports are not overwritten. Retaining one original task baseline across corrections remains a workflow obligation.
Comparison requires compatible tool/settings/scope identity; missing native numeric evidence remains unknown rather than zero.
Installed runtime resources and pins come from one installation; refresh preserves unrelated target files, target policy, native environments and reports.
Measurement never installs packages and colocated hashes do not establish tamper resistance.
